name: Drawn to Making
thesis: Real Archivo letterforms are plotted in cream and lilac above an oversized purple Monstrosity, with a quiet personal letter carrying the reader into the human side of making.
interaction: Draw my name traces genuine glyph contours in a six-second sequence; a tiny nib lifts between contours and a final fill completes the identity. Finish instantly, follow project links, or read the full personal letter. Reduced-motion visitors retain the completed name.
why: Refines 23’s plotting idea without a cartoon machine, builds on 06’s huge type and genuine artifact composition, and combines 05’s midnight purple with 21’s intimate writing.
